turns.user: I have a valid Budapest pass and want to bring one dog on a tram within Budapest. Does it need its own ticket?
turns.agent:
Based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, if your valid Budapest pass is one that covers your tram trip, you may take one dog free of charge within Budapest; the dog does not need its own ticket. Outside a suitable fully closed carrier, the dog must be leashed and muzzled, and you should carry valid animal vaccination documentation. A dog in a suitable fully closed carrier can travel without a separate animal ticket as well.

See BKK’s Dogs on public transport (https://bkk.hu/en/travel-information/dogs-on-public-transport/) page for the official conditions. This is snapshot-based guidance, not live verification.
turns.turn_assessment: First turn meets expected criteria on free dog carriage with a valid pass and explains animal safety rules. Second turn pending.

turns.user: The dog won't be in a carrier. What safety rules should I follow?
turns.agent:
For a dog outside a carrier, the snapshot says to keep it on a leash and muzzled. Carry valid animal vaccination documentation too. Since you have a valid Budapest pass and are taking one dog on a tram within Budapest, the snapshot supports that the dog travels free of charge under those conditions.

See BKK’s Dogs on public transport (https://bkk.hu/en/travel-information/dogs-on-public-transport/) page for the official rules. This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check; confirm the current conditions with BKK.
turns.turn_assessment: Correctly states leash, muzzle, vaccination document and pass-based free travel for a dog outside a carrier.
